title: Exposed Wiring Loom
description: Protective sheathing split on main wiring loom beneath driver's console. Multiple bare conductors visible. Fire risk if left unaddressed.

title: Brake Pad Wear — Front Axle
description: Front nearside and offside brake pads worn below 3mm minimum threshold. Brake performance noticeably reduced during inspection test.
notes: Bus withdrawn from service pending pad replacement. Parts on order.

title: Oil Leak — Gearbox Seal
description: Steady oil drip from gearbox rear output seal. Pooling on bay floor beneath Bus VH-1654. Estimated loss of 200ml over 8 hours.
notes: Absorbent matting placed under vehicle. Seal replacement booked for next maintenance window.

title: Passenger Door Actuator Failure
description: Rear passenger door failing to fully open on actuation. Door travels approximately 60% of range before stalling. Obstruction or actuator motor fault suspected.
location: Bay 5, Bus VH-2103, Rear Passenger Door

title: Cracked Windscreen
description: Impact crack on driver's side windscreen originating from lower edge. Crack length approximately 280mm and propagating toward centre. Fails visual obstruction check.
notes: Windscreen replaced by approved glazing contractor. Signed off and returned to service 2024-10-22.

title: AdBlue System Warning
description: Persistent AdBlue system fault code logged on Bus VH-2210. DEF injector pressure reading out of range. Risk of engine derate if unresolved.
location: Bay 6, Bus VH-2210, Exhaust After-treatment System
notes: Diagnostic tool connected. Awaiting readout from OEM remote support team.

title: Depot Roller Door Obstruction Sensor Fault
description: Bay 9 roller door obstruction sensor not triggering door reversal during close cycle. Safety-critical fault — door must not be used until resolved.
notes: Bay 9 cordoned off. Manual operation prohibited.

title: Tyre Pressure Below Threshold — Rear Axle
description: Nearside rear dual tyres on Bus VH-1763 reading 88 PSI against a required 110 PSI. Slow puncture or valve fault suspected.
location: Bay 4, Bus VH-1763, Rear Nearside Axle
notes: Faulty valve core replaced on both rear nearside tyres. Pressures verified at 110 PSI. Returned to service 2024-10-19.

title: Coolant Temperature Sensor Misread
description: Engine coolant temperature sensor on Bus VH-2334 intermittently reporting values 40°C above expected operating range. No physical overheating confirmed — suspected faulty sensor or loose connector.
notes: Live data being monitored via diagnostic interface. Awaiting second occurrence to confirm sensor fault before replacing.

title: CCTV Camera Blind Spot — Rear Saloon
description: Rear saloon CCTV camera on Bus VH-1901 has a partial obstruction covering approximately 30% of its field of view. Cause unclear — possible internal condensation or physical displacement of unit.
location: Bay 11, Bus VH-1901, Rear Saloon Ceiling
notes: Camera footage reviewed. Safety compliance team assessing whether vehicle can remain in service while investigation continues.

title: Suspension Knocking — Front Offside
description: Audible knocking from front offside suspension reported by driver of Bus VH-2567 during pre-departure check. Noise present at low speed over uneven surfaces. Worn bush or loose anti-roll bar link suspected.
location: Bay 2, Bus VH-2567, Front Offside Suspension
notes: Vehicle held from service. Physical inspection underway — ramp lift booked for 14:00 today.

title: Fuel Cap Seal Deterioration
description: Fuel cap seal on Bus VH-3012 visibly cracked and hardened. Faint fuel odour detected during walkaround inspection. Risk of fuel vapour escape.
location: Bay 3, Bus VH-3012, Fuel Filler Cap

title: Handbrake Ineffective — Stationary Hold
description: Bus VH-2789 failed stationary hold test on incline during pre-departure check. Handbrake lever travel excessive and vehicle rolled approximately 15cm before stopping.

title: Interior Lighting Failure — Lower Saloon
description: Four fluorescent strip lights in the lower saloon of Bus VH-1654 not illuminating. Remaining lights unaffected. Possible ballast failure or wiring fault on that circuit.
location: Bay 1, Bus VH-1654, Lower Saloon Ceiling

title: Power Steering Fluid Low
description: Power steering fluid reservoir on Bus VH-3105 reading below minimum marker. No visible external leak identified. Steering feel noticeably heavier than expected at low speed.

title: Rear Fog Light Inoperative
description: Nearside rear fog light on Bus VH-2041 not illuminating when activated. Bulb replacement attempted — fault persists. Wiring or switch fault suspected.
location: Bay 3, Bus VH-2041, Rear Light Cluster

title: Driver Seat Adjustment Rail Seized
description: Seat fore-aft adjustment rail on Bus VH-2334 is fully seized. Driver unable to reposition seat. Rail appears corroded. Non-compliant for drivers outside standard height range.

title: Windscreen Washer Pump Failure
description: Windscreen washer pump on Bus VH-1887 not activating when stalk operated. Reservoir confirmed full. No fluid reaching screen — pump motor suspected failed.

title: Battery Voltage Drop — Auxiliary System
description: Auxiliary battery on Bus VH-3210 showing resting voltage of 11.4V against expected 12.6V. Destination board and saloon lighting flickering intermittently during idle.

title: Exhaust Mount Bracket Cracked
description: Rear exhaust mount bracket on Bus VH-2103 has a visible stress fracture. Exhaust section hanging lower than nominal position. Vibration and potential contact with underfloor components if left unaddressed.

title: Step Well Grab Rail Loose
description: Front step well grab rail on Bus VH-2567 has two fixing bolts backed out. Rail has approximately 8mm of play. Passenger injury risk — bus should not carry standing passengers until resolved.
location: Bay 2, Bus VH-2567, Front Step Well

title: DEF Tank Level Sensor Fault
description: DEF tank level sensor on Bus VH-3105 displaying full reading despite tank confirmed empty on physical inspection. Risk of engine derate without accurate level monitoring.
notes: Sensor wiring harness inspected — connector reseated. Monitoring for recurrence before ordering replacement sensor.

title: Bay 4 Compressed Air Line Leak
description: Audible air leak from compressed air supply line at Bay 4 quick-release coupling. Pressure drop of approximately 8 PSI per minute observed at the manifold gauge.
notes: Bay 4 air supply isolated at main valve. Tools requiring compressed air rerouted to Bay 3 supply.
